name: com.cwcbb.cwcroombuilder
displayName: CwcRoomBuilder - Grid-Based Procedural Room & Dungeon Builder
description: A lightweight, artist-friendly grid-based procedural room and dungeon generation tool for Unity. Features interactive Scene-view brush painting, automatic wall/floor/ceiling structure assembly, DoorPin openings, 2D SDF distance fields with gradient vector alignment, and 3D OBB collision-free prop decoration with nested slots.
